{"consolidated_memory":"RECURRING ISSUE: NaN feature in the feature encoder (ml/features/encoder.py, ml pipeline side)

Common characteristics across all occasions:
- Component: ml/features/encoder.py (same corner of the code base)
- Repro: encode the batch holding the sparse column
- Signal: a not-a-number value in one output column
- Language: Python

OCCASION 1 - [2026-01-13]
- Trigger: appeared only after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Result: memory settled at 388 MB instead of climbing past 1 GB
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR #2651 on branch fix/nan-feature-1

OCCASION 2 - [2026-01-18]
- Trigger: appeared only for payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Result: cold start dropped 8 percent, to 549 ms
- Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR #3423 on branch fix/nan-feature-2
- Test coverage: tests/ml/test_encoder.py

OCCASION 3 - [2026-03-02]
- Trigger: appeared only when two requests raced on the same key
- Root cause: schema drift between the migration and the model
- Result: the job finished in 62 minutes instead of 2 hours
- Fix: regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
- PR #5096 on branch fix/nan-feature-3

OCCASION 4 - [2026-08-13]
- Trigger: appeared only after the client had already retried once
- Root cause: clock skew between the two hosts
- Result: the nightly rollup matched the source counts for 44 days running
- Fix: switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR #7330 on branch fix/nan-feature-4

Note: Each fix was applied in the same corner of ml/features/encoder.py, with context carrying over from earlier work."}
